title: Settings
gridMaxRows: Maximum rows loaded into a grid
gridMaxCells: Maximum cells loaded into a grid
gridHint: Loading stops when either limit is reached. Higher limits use more memory.

validation.rows: Rows must be a whole number from 1,000 to 5,000,000
validation.cells: Cells must be a whole number from 100,000 to 200,000,000

appearance.hint: Font sizes are independent (pixels). Changes apply when you save. Unavailable fonts use the system fallback.

planAdvisorMetadata: Match advice against existing indexes (reads the catalog)
planAdvisorMetadataHint: The Query Advisor reads the indexes, columns and row counts of the tables in a plan to avoid duplicate suggestions. It only reads; it never runs your statement.
